what_data_show: Song explains 49% of valence and 67% of arousal variance; person habit 4% each; personal reaction 47% (valence) and 29% (arousal).
what_stats_show: Crossed random effects variance decomposition (song, person, residual).
what_we_infer: Ratings are largely stimulus driven, but enough person specific variance remains to ask the person specific question, more so for valence.
what_is_uncertain: Residual mixes true personal reaction with rating noise; one retrospective rating per excerpt.

what_data_show: Arousal separates the intended categories clearly; valence is compressed (no song mean below 3.1); Neutral songs were mildly positive and calm.
what_stats_show: Song level means by intended category (p1_song_map).
what_we_infer: The arousal manipulation worked; the negative valence manipulation was weak.
what_is_uncertain: Restricted low valence range limits power for valence effects.

what_data_show: Weak positive correlation: rho about 0.19 pooled, mean 0.18 within person (range -0.22 to 0.60).
what_stats_show: Spearman correlations pooled and per participant.
what_we_infer: Valence and arousal are largely separable, so H1 and H2 test different things.
what_is_uncertain: Individual correlations from 20 ratings each are noisy.

what_data_show: 400 pairs; 399 files; 396 pass EEG QC (sub-12 t05 truncated, sub-14 t06 26 epochs, sub-18 t17 0 epochs); 395 analysed after excluding sub-01 t27; 213 recordings had a flagged channel, only 12 inside H1/H2 regions.
what_stats_show: Rules fixed in the preregistration before EEG-rating analysis.
what_we_infer: Data loss is small and unrelated to ratings, so bias from exclusions is unlikely.
what_is_uncertain: Upstream preprocessing is partly undocumented; flagged channels were dropped, not interpolated.

finding: Step 17: naive vs two-stage vs between-person
what_stats_show: Naive pooling uses n = 395 and gives an interval that is too narrow; the valid analyses use n = 20 people.
what_we_infer: Trials are not independent; within and between person questions must be kept apart.
what_is_uncertain: Here pooling did not create a false positive, but its precision is overstated.

what_data_show: Slightly positive association, opposite to the predicted sign.
what_stats_show: b = 0.003 [-0.003, 0.008], standardized 0.05 [-0.05, 0.15], p = .355 (random intercepts only after singular fit).
what_we_infer: H1 not supported. Within person negative effects stronger than about -0.05 SD are unlikely given these data.
what_is_uncertain: Ratings are retrospective; alpha averaged over 2 minutes; onset time assumed; lower alpha has many causes besides arousal.

what_we_infer: H2 not supported. Effects larger than about 0.11 SD in either direction are unlikely.
what_is_uncertain: Compressed valence range; FAA has a mixed replication record; average reference affects FAA.

what_data_show: Deviation slopes are near zero for both outcomes.
what_stats_show: H1 deviation: standardized 0.05 [-0.05, 0.15], p = .342. H2 deviation: 0.04 [-0.06, 0.15], p = .386.
what_we_infer: No evidence that the personal part of the experience is reflected in these EEG measures.
what_is_uncertain: Deviation scores contain rating noise, which attenuates slopes.

what_data_show: Consensus slopes are near zero (H1 0.03, H2 -0.03 standardized).
what_is_uncertain: Consensus is confounded with acoustics and cannot be interpreted as an emotion effect.

what_data_show: Raw per person slopes look variable, but shrunken slopes collapse toward the mean.
what_stats_show: LR = 0.01 (p mixture = .949, slope SD = 0.000) for H1; LR = 1.15 (p = .424, slope SD = 0.006) for H2; models singular, CI not estimable.
what_we_infer: H3 not supported; spread is consistent with sampling noise.
what_is_uncertain: About 20 trials per person gives little power to estimate slope variance.

what_data_show: 3 of 105 tests had uncorrected p < .05 (central beta and alpha with arousal; right temporal gamma with valence), about the 5 expected by chance.
what_stats_show: No test survived BH FDR; smallest q = 0.996.
what_we_infer: No exploratory leads strong enough to prioritise; the gamma hit is muscle sensitive.
what_is_uncertain: Many models in the grid were singular for the song random effect.

what_data_show: Standardized H1 slopes ranged 0.03 to 0.06 and H2 -0.01 to 0.05 across four alternative specifications; LOSO H1 0.0016 to 0.0037, H2 -0.0015 to 0.0028 (raw).
what_stats_show: All p > .25 for H1 and > .50 for H2.
what_we_infer: The null conclusions do not depend on any single analytic choice or participant.
what_is_uncertain: Presentation order check could not be run (timestamps repeat).
